CShapes codes de jure borders and omits changes under 10,000 km²; areas not held by any state or dependency in CShapes (e.g. Antarctica, some unclaimed or undefined interiors) are absent. Dependencies carry status and owner. Ids are ISO3 of today's successor where the polity is essentially the same; otherwise short codes (AUH, USSR, OTT, YUG, CSK, BRD, DDR, RAJ, …) or ISO 3166-2 codes for former colonies that are today one subdivision (US-AK, AU-NSW).
